+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: doing
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: 'Undo the RealModel test-target rename: the two integration targets end in IntegrationTests again'
+---
+Commit `1db2b56` renamed the two real-model test targets without a good reason.
+The names must go back to a form that ends in `IntegrationTests`.
+
+## What to do
+
+- [ ] Rename target and directory `FoundationModelsRouterRealModelTests` back to `FoundationModelsRouterIntegrationTests`.
+- [ ] Rename target and directory `FoundationModelsRouterRealModelEvals` to `FoundationModelsRouterEvalIntegrationTests`.
+- [ ] Update `Package.swift`, `Scripts/swift-test.sh`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `README.md`, and every doc comment or card that names an old target.
+- [ ] Revert the suite renames that `1db2b56` made only to make a shared `CompactionSmoke` substring.
+
+Both target names then end in `IntegrationTests`, so one word selects or excludes both:
+
+```
+swift test --skip IntegrationTests
+swift test --filter IntegrationTests
+```
+
+## What must stay
+
+- The 16 deleted environment variables and their `.enabled(if:)` traits stay deleted.
+- The target split stays: `FoundationModelsRouterEvalSupport` as a plain target, and the hermetic evals apart from the real-model evals.
+- The `internal` to `package` widening stays.
+- `Scripts/swift-test.sh` stays.
+
+## Known facts
+
+Swift Testing has tags, but SwiftPM cannot select by tag. `--filter` and `--skip`
+are a regular expression over `<test-target>.<test-case>` only. The target is
+therefore the unit of selection. Do not add tags.
+#tests #test-debt
\ No newline at end of file
